_README: CANONICAL measured figures. Every gas or ratio claim in prose (CLAUDE.md,
README.md, docs/, NatSpec, commit messages) must agree with this file, and
this file is enforced by Measurements.test.js, which RE-MEASURES each entry
rather than trusting it.
Why this exists: three strategic conclusions in this project were reversed
because a number was wrong, and each reversal was then APPENDED next to the
wrong claim instead of replacing it. A later reader — including a later
session — met the stale claim first and re-derived from it. The 'skip t=16'
decision was made from a >100M figure that was already known to be an
artefact. Prose cannot be kept in sync by discipline alone; this file can be
kept in sync by CI.
HOW TO MEASURE (the three mistakes that produced the reversals):
1. A gasLimit above 2^24 is REJECTED BEFORE EXECUTION (EIP-7825). A
rejection is not an out-of-gas. Always confirm the call actually ran.
2. estimateGas over-provisions nested calls by ~3x (63/64 rule per frame).
Measure gasUsed of a SENT transaction; for a view function, binary
search the smallest passing gasLimit.
3. In a RATIO, shared overhead must cancel. Two single external calls both
carry the 21,000 transaction base, which inflates the smaller one and
understates the ratio. Measure marginally: gas(n+1) - gas(n).
Tolerance is 3%: compiler and fixture regeneration move these slightly, a
real regression moves them much more.

nonce_transition_verify.what: BatchRegistryV7.submitNonceTransition with ONE update — the nonce accumulator's whole on-chain cost, dominated by its own verifyRecursive. Constant in N.
nonce_transition_verify.how: contracts/test/BatchRegistryV7Accumulator.test.js sends the transaction and reads gasUsed. Fixture: nonce_accumulator_e2e.json (cargo test write_nonce_accumulator_fixture -- --ignored).
nonce_transition_verify.note: THIS NUMBER REFUTES § A-4's CENTRAL CLAIM in the separate-proof form. Against the mapping's measured 12,085 gas per RETURNING sender it only pays above ~569 senders, and one transaction admits ~172. So the accumulator as a SEPARATE proof does not reach break-even — it is dearer than the mapping at every N the cap allows.
nonce_transition_verify.and_it_does_not_fit_with_a_batch: 14,663,950 (v7_tree_submitBatch) + 6,882,057 = 21,546,007 against a 16,777,216 cap. The first design took the batch bundles in the same call and reverted; that is how this was measured rather than assumed. Hence submitNonceTransition is its own transaction.
nonce_transition_verify.what_would_fix_it: Fold the nonce statement into the batch proof as a further path group in composition_channel_t8::node_shape, so it rides the two verifyRecursive calls already being paid for instead of adding a third. The separate proof was recorded as 'simpler and cheaper'; only the first half was true.

nonce_transition_marginal.what: Marginal gas per additional update in submitNonceTransition, measured 1 -> 25 updates.
nonce_transition_marginal.how: Same test. Marginally, so the ~6.9M constant cancels.
nonce_transition_marginal.note: STORAGE is O(1) — one slot holds the whole replay state whatever N is — but this is still HIGHER than the mapping's 12,085 per returning sender, so the accumulator loses on the marginal as well as on the constant. Two contributors, both addressable: nonceStatementBinding concatenates with abi.encodePacked in a loop, which is O(n^2) in memory, and a 25-update statement has a larger inner trace (log 10 vs 9) than a 1-update one.

outer_recursion_verify_t8.what: VFRI11 verify of the OUTER recursion trace (87 cols, log=14, inner n_queries=20)

outer_recursion_verify_t16.what: VFRI12 verify of the same outer trace — 96% of the cap, which is why a fully t=16 recursion does not fit

v7_tree_submitBatch.what: BatchRegistryV7.submitBatch finalizing a BATCH of signatures from the aggregation tree's two roots, at production n_queries=20 (130-bit FRI).
v7_tree_submitBatch.how: cargo test write_tree_recursive_bundles_fixture -- --ignored; then contracts/test/BatchRegistryV7TreeE2E.test.js sends the tx and reads gasUsed.
v7_tree_submitBatch.note: merkleRoot here is R, the membership root DERIVED from the proofs and used as the Fiat-Shamir seed, with txListRoot carried alongside as the (attested, unproved) transaction-list commitment. Constant in N: the root node's shape is a fixed point, so two signatures measure the same as many. The fixture's fold count is derived from each root's DEPTH, not the leaves' — a tree root sits at depth 15/14 where a V23 group sits at 10/8, so inheriting the leaves' 6 folds put 512 last-layer evaluations on chain instead of 16 and the call reverted. Measuring the outer trace alone and inferring the total was the error.

v7_sender_marginal_cold.what: Marginal gas per additional FIRST-TIME sender in BatchRegistryV7.submitBatchWithNonces, measured 10 -> 25 senders.
v7_sender_marginal_cold.how: contracts/test/V7SenderCostProbe.test.js sends batches at 1/10/25 senders on fresh registries and differences the gasUsed, so the ~14.7M shared batch cost and the 21,000 tx base cancel.
v7_sender_marginal_cold.note: FIRST-TIME: a fresh registry means every sender writes a ZERO slot, so this carries SSTORE_SET (20,000) + the cold-slot surcharge (2,100). USE THIS FOR THE CEILING — how many senders fit one transaction must hold in the worst case, a batch of all-new senders. Do NOT use it for break-even; see v7_sender_marginal_warm. GROWS with n (26,065 at 1->10) because of the O(n^2) duplicate scan.
v7_sender_marginal_cold.corrected: Was named `v7_sender_marginal` and used for BOTH the ceiling and break-even. The harness comment beside it already said 'a warm senderNonces slot costs less than a cold one', but the consequence never reached ROADMAP § 1.5 — so prose drifted from a number inside the file that exists to prevent exactly that. Renamed so the name states which case it measures.

v7_sender_marginal_warm.what: Marginal gas per additional RETURNING sender — one that appeared in an earlier batch, so its senderNonces slot is already non-zero.
v7_sender_marginal_warm.how: contracts/test/V7SenderCostProbe.test.js on NonceLoopHarness (contracts/src/test/), which carries BatchRegistryV7's nonce block verbatim. Two calls into ONE harness: the first warms the slots, the second is measured. The real contract cannot produce this — a second batch needs a second merkleRoot, finalizedBatches rejects a repeat, and a different root needs different cross-bound proofs.
v7_sender_marginal_warm.note: USE THIS FOR BREAK-EVEN — it is what a running system pays for almost every sender; the first-time cost is paid once per sender ever. The difference from the cold figure is 17,100 gas, which is EXACTLY SSTORE_SET (20,000) - SSTORE_RESET (2,900).
v7_sender_marginal_warm.harness_validated: A harness measured only against itself measures nothing. The same test cross-checks it against the real contract on the TWO points the real contract CAN produce before using its third: cold 29,185 vs 28,777 (1.4%) and warm-within-one-transaction 12,946 vs 12,538 (3.3%), both inside a 5% bound. If V7's loop changes and the harness's does not, that check fails.
v7_sender_marginal_warm.consequence: The correction moves the numbers a lot and does NOT overturn the conclusion. Compared consistently at the steady-state marginal: break-even needs N > 359 and one transaction holds ~172 senders, so break-even stays OUTSIDE the ceiling and the nonce accumulator (§ A-4) is still the lever that reaches profitability. What changes is the margin — the gap narrows from ~8.4x (607 needed against 72 reachable, both on the cold figure) to ~2.1x. The worst-case ceiling, which is what a safety limit must use, stays at ~71.

_note: Reproduced against a standalone `npx hardhat node` (real JSON-RPC), NOT the
in-process test EVM and NOT a public testnet — outbound RPC is blocked in
this environment. A public-testnet run remains OUTSTANDING before mainnet.

v8_stack_tx0_path.what: SUPERSEDED. real ML-DSA-65 signatures -> V23 -> VFRI11 (20 queries) -> recursion -> BatchRegistryV7.submitBatchWithNonces, ONE transaction
v8_stack_tx0_path.superseded: This measured the path that proved tx[0] only. Ф2.3 (2026-10-04) moved --stack v8 onto the aggregation tree, so the same command now proves ALL N signatures and costs more. Kept because README quoted this figure as the one to expect.

v8_stack_full_e2e.what: real ML-DSA-65 signatures -> V23 -> aggregation tree over ALL N -> recursion -> BatchRegistryV7.submitBatchWithNonces, ONE transaction. 2 transactions, 2 first-time senders.
v8_stack_full_e2e.reconciles: 14,663,950 (v7_tree_submitBatch, no senders) + 2 first-time sender writes at ~28,777 = ~14,721,504. The 3,198 difference is calldata for the two senders and their nonces.
v8_stack_full_e2e.note: Run against a standalone `npx hardhat node` after the Ф2.3 wiring and the three ABI fixes of 2026-10-04 — the first end-to-end confirmation that the submission path works at all, since those ABIs had made it impossible.
